# Interview guide (fixture)

Invented for the construct-glossary fixture. It answers the provenance check —
the file exists and is readable — and does not support any definition.

## turns

Ask each participant how many times they spoke in the meeting just recorded,
and how that compares with their usual participation.

## safety

Ask what a participant would expect to happen after raising a concern in the
meeting, and whether anything changed that expectation during the study.
